# A render slot re-renders on what its structure reads, and a prop in its body
# is patched where it stands -- executed on every target that runs a test.
#
# testdata/slot_body_updates_in_place.txtar is the code: a tick writes
# `uptime`, and on html, fyne and gtk4 that hands the live instances holding
# the panel and the rows their new value, rather than re-firing the slots that
# rebuilt them. What a golden cannot show is that the patch lands: each
# snapshot has the panel and every row reading the current value: after two
# ticks, and after the panel was hidden, ticked past and shown again -- the
# render building the panel from the value it has now, since a hidden panel
# holds no instance for a tick to reach. One snapshot per test, because a
# second snapshot in one gtk4 test paints an empty window.
#
# The panel holds an input nobody binds, whose text is state of its own
# instance: the "typed" snapshot is taken after a tick, and the text is still
# there only if the tick patched the panel rather than building a new one. A
# test reaches the input through its `#id` although the panel is a component
# built at run time: on html the invoker finds the element by its mark, and on
# fyne and gtk4 the instance hands its widget to the Model as it is built.
#
# The interpreter's, html's and bubbletea's snapshots are text and are read
# here; fyne's, gtk4's and android's are images, kept with the recorded runs.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'
grep '(?s)text\(value="up 2"\).*text\(value="a at 2"\)\n    text\(value="b at 2"\)' app.sngl.snapshots/ticked.sngl
grep '(?s)text\(value="up 1"\).*text\(value="a at 1"\)\n    text\(value="b at 1"\)' app.sngl.snapshots/reshown.sngl
grep 'text\(value="up 1"\)\n        input\(placeholder="type here", value="typed"\)' app.sngl.snapshots/typed.sngl

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'
grep '<span>up 2</span><div style="display: contents;"><input data-sngl-id="field" type="" placeholder="type here"></div></div></div></span>' app.sngl.snapshots/ticked.html
grep '<span>a at 2</span></div><div style="display: contents;"><span>b at 2</span>' app.sngl.snapshots/ticked.html
grep '<span>up 1</span><div style="display: contents;"><input data-sngl-id="field" type="" placeholder="type here"></div></div></div></span>' app.sngl.snapshots/reshown.html
grep '<span>up 1</span><div style="display: contents;"><input data-sngl-id="field" type="" placeholder="type here" value="typed">' app.sngl.snapshots/typed.html
grep '<span>a at 1</span></div><div style="display: contents;"><span>b at 1</span>' app.sngl.snapshots/reshown.html

sngl test --platform=bubbletea app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'
grep '(?s)up 2.*a at 2.*b at 2' app.sngl.snapshots/ticked.ansi
grep '(?s)up 1.*a at 1.*b at 1' app.sngl.snapshots/reshown.ansi
grep '(?s)up 1.*typed' app.sngl.snapshots/typed.ansi

sngl test --platform=fyne app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --opt testRunner=robolectric app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

[!gtk4] stop 'gtk4 needs its development libraries to build'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 app.sngl
stdout 'ok   3 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import . "sngl:ui"

component main node {
    var shown = true
    var uptime = 0
    var items = ["a", "b"]

    vbox {
        button #tick(text="tick", @click { uptime += 1 })
        button #flip(text="flip", @click { shown = !shown })
        if shown {
            vbox {
                text(value="static")
                text(value="up {uptime}")
                input #field(placeholder="type here")
            }
        }
        for var it = items {
            text(value="{it} at {uptime}")
        }
    }
}

func testTickPatchesInPlace(t Test, c main) {
    c.tick.click()
    c.tick.click()
    t.snapshot("ticked")
    t.assert(c.uptime == 2)
}

func testTypedTextSurvivesATick(t Test, c main) {
    c.field.input({value="typed"})
    c.tick.click()
    t.snapshot("typed")
    t.assert(c.uptime == 1)
}

func testReshownReadsTheCurrentValue(t Test, c main) {
    c.flip.click()
    c.tick.click()
    c.flip.click()
    t.snapshot("reshown")
    t.assert(c.uptime == 1)
}

window {
    main
}
